note: THE MARRIAGE BOOK. Forty-seven years in ONE volume, about five images a year. Zambrone is in the DISTRETTO DI MONTELEONE and the circondario of TROPEA, not Briatico. STRUCTURE, worked out by sampling: each year runs a printed TITLE PAGE, then its acts one to an opening, then an ANNUAL TAVOLA ruled for «Nomi e Cognomi degli Sposi | Patria | NOMI E COGNOMI DE' GENITORI | Giorno in cui si celebro il Matrimonio | Osservazioni» -- the same four-parents-per-couple index as Briatico's. CALIBRATION: image 10 = 1822 act 5; image 13 = TAVOLA 1822 (5 marriages); image 19 = title page 1823; images 21-26 = the acts of 1824; image 27 = TAVOLA 1824 (3 marriages); image 28 = title page 1825; image 30 = 1825 act 2; image 50 = 1830 act 1. So a whole year costs ONE IMAGE once the Tavola is located, and the first fifty images cover 1811 to 1830 entire.
